name: timetable-app
description: Standalone timetable management app based on LEOS scheduling logic

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,ui -c cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
